schema_note: An INSTANCE artifact over the model's configuration layer (../../model/council.json). A configuration is a type; a charter is a seated council: type + roll + grant + referral + instructions + pins. Fields marked DECLARED cannot be derived by the engine; everything else the server computes. The vocabulary is the model's own (motion/*, action/*, guard/*, params, overlay ops) so that ../tools/check-charter.py can resolve every reference mechanically.
kind_cite: 50:3, 50:10 — a special committee carries out a specified task and ceases to exist on presenting its final report

parliamentary_authority.pinned: DECLARED at seating: git blob/tree hash of ../../model/ (this is the council's adoption of its parliamentary authority, 2:15; pin = edition per ROADMAP phase 5)
parliamentary_authority.errata: bug-fix releases within the pinned line count as errata and apply without in-band adoption; a change to any admissibility expression is an edition change and requires the parent's instruction [13:22]
parliamentary_authority.model_defect_path: a council that believes the model is wrong records a point of order against the model in its report; it may suspend the rule (two-thirds) if suspendible [25], and the parent may ratify the act [10:54]

configuration_cite: council.json: committee extends small-board; 49:21 relaxations apply unless instructed otherwise [50:25]

authority.decided_by_on_report: delegated — until the parent supports / ratifies / rules / declines (udon adr/decision-authority.md)

parent_powers.power: give subsequent instructions, majority, any time before the report
discharge; bare majority if the reporting deadline below was missed or while a partial report is under consideration

adopt, amend, or decline the report; the veto outside the tool is declining adoption

roll.desc: DECLARED. Seat identity is member identity: a seat re-forked from the same source between sittings is the same member for every rule that counts members. agent.identity follows vsect: harness-agent | harness-session | declared.
roll.cite: 50:18 — a committee for deliberation 'should represent, as far as possible, all points of view'; 13:15 — non-members of the parent may sit with the parent's approval, which this act is

agent.key: DECLARED at seating (CC_AGENT key of the fork)

seats.perspective: a reader who opens the file without vsect: grep, GitHub, a cold agent
the commit seam: worktrees, rebases, hashes cited as evidence

officers.chair_desc: the server performs every chair action that is a duty (actions.json chair_duty_note: 'where exactly one chair action is admissible the list is also the obligation'); every judgment predicate the chair would rule on is SUBMITTED to the council [23:18-21], because a mechanical chair is always 'in doubt'. Lost: the chair's sua-sponte duties (dilatory 39, 13:9; decorum 43; denying recognition to an obstructive member 50:25 n7) — any seat may raise them by point of order instead. Alternative values: 'seat/<id>' (member-chair, 49:21(7) chair participates) or 'elected' (13:18).
officers.secretary: server (the event log is the record; minutes are a projection, 48:2-5)
officers.tellers: none (01 §5: no ballot meaning to adjudicate)

quorum.cite: 40:5 — 'a rule of the parent body … or the motion establishing the particular committee' may set a committee's quorum; default would be a majority (2 of 3). DECLARED at 3 because every seat was chosen for a perspective the decision needs.

referred.question: question/vsect-closed-lines
referred.form: main-motion referral — a task assigned when no question was pending in the parent [13:6]; the committee's recommendation re-pends in the parent only by a new main motion [36:11, 51:11]
referred.text: Resolved, That vsect keep the computed frontmatter lines (closed:, owner:) on item files and sync them from the event trail.
advisory_inputs: specimens-2026-11-03.md Reply 1 item 7 and Reply 2 item 6 (the 189 drifted files; the 17-of-18 close commits)
referred.cite: 50:19 — the secretary furnishes the referred papers and the instructions

agenda.desc: DERIVED for a special committee: the referred question is the special order for the meeting [41:57], taken up as soon as the council is called to order; nothing else may be taken up except privileged, subsidiary and incidental motions arising from it [9:15 by analogy: the referral is the call]. The council cannot amend this agenda; it may only report, or ask the parent for instructions [52:15].

instructions.desc: DECLARED. Binding on the committee [13:8(d)]; adoptable by the parent by majority 'even when it contains instructions that suspend, modify, or conflict with rules of order that would otherwise apply to meetings of the committee' [13:8(d)].

list.cite: 13:8(d) 'when it is to report'; 36:4(7) makes discharge a majority matter if missed

list.value: charge, facts, findings, recommendation as a resolution [51:7]; every seat's vote with its stated reasons [48:5(2c)]; minority views included as of right, not by leave

list.cite: 13:8(d) 'can be authorized … even to add to its own membership'

value.returns_as: advisory input to the pending question, in the nature of debate

list.cite: 13:8(d) 'employ an expert consultant'; 50:15 subcommittees need parent authorization to include non-members; 52:28 breakout reports 'are in the nature of debate'
13:8(d); 15:16 budget closure: interruption time does not diminish the allowance; 50:25 (the committee may not impose this on itself; the parent may)
50:26 — a committee may not adopt its own rules except as authorized

list.value: never; the parent is entitled to the whole record

overlay.desc: Applied at load after the committee configuration's own overlay. Scope of restrict_actions is DECLARED as member-initiated: chair and secretary duties are never whitelisted because duties are not options (see ../model-defects.md F1).

ops.note: the model's type is {max_speeches, max_minutes}; minutes→tokens per ../03-logical-time.md

ops.cite: 50:23 all meetings of a special committee are one session

excluded_with_reason.motion/main-motion: a special committee considers only what was referred; new business is out of order [9:15 analog, 36:2]; the referred question pends without a motion [51:40]
excluded_with_reason.motion/lay-on-table: nothing to set the one question aside for; waiting on an inquiry is recess or adjourn-to-event (../04-machinery-survey.md)
excluded_with_reason.motion/call-for-orders-of-the-day: no orders beyond the one special order; harmless but idle
excluded_with_reason.motion/limit-extend-debate: already disabled by the committee configuration [50:25]; the debate-budget instruction is the parent's order instead
excluded_with_reason.motion/previous-question: as above [50:25]; exhaustion is a full pass round (01 §3 g)
excluded_with_reason.motion/motions-relating-to-voting: the voting method is fixed by the electronic-meeting rules; a roll-call cannot be 'ordered' because it is already the method
excluded_with_reason.motion/motions-relating-to-nominations: no elections with a mechanical chair
excluded_with_reason.motion/reconsider-enter-minutes: its object is protecting absentees across a day boundary; every seat is present every round, and a special committee has one session [50:23]

ops.cite: 52:9 is the precedent for defining a body by an enumerated permitted set
8:2(4); its object is the chair's consultation — a mechanical chair consults nobody; recess serves the council

action.note: the committee's only exit [50:23]: rise = adjourn sine die; on adoption the server emits the report (report-form instruction) to the parent and the council dissolves [50:10, 36:8]. Adopting it while the referred question is undisposed reports 'unable to arrive at a recommendation' [51:37]. Shape copied from committee-of-the-whole's move-rise [52:9].

requires_schema: ctx.subcommittees — gaps.json committee-identity; Committee {id, kind, roll, charter_ref, parent, state}
action.note: in order while any question is pending; does NOT touch the pending stack (the pending question stays pending — this is not subsidiary commit). On adoption: effect spawn-subcommittee with a derived special charter (parent = this council, referred = brief); its report returns as event subcommittee-reported attaching an advisory input to the pending question — in the nature of debate [52:28], gating nothing. Without this instruction the generic model still offers the route raise-question-of-privilege [19:7 'organization'] → admissibility submitted → context push → main motion → pop; see ../05-in-meeting-acts.md.

in order while any question is pending (a question of the privileges of the assembly — its organization [19:7] — pre-admitted by instruction). On adoption: effect seat-member; event member-seated; quorum recomputed if basis is a majority [40:5]; the new seat's counters are fresh; it is present once it first submits; its first state delta is the whole record. The new member may vote on the pending question (RONR: any member present votes); the record shows when it joined. Removal mirrors adoption thresholds [50:14].

ops.replace: the reporting member of a SUBCOMMITTEE reports to this council at any round boundary (reports are received, not scheduled, in a one-question committee); the report attaches as an advisory input and emits subcommittee-reported

electronic_meeting_rules.cite: 9:35 (authorization in the establishing act), 9:36 (what the rules must cover), Sample Rules A §3-5, §7, §9, §11
electronic_meeting_rules.unit_of_simultaneity: the round: every present seat receives state s_k and may submit intents formed against s_k; no event k+1 is applied until every present seat has had that opportunity; intents are sealed until the round closes (../01 §3, the common-state condition)
electronic_meeting_rules.presence_and_quorum: presence declared at call to order by a roll round [Sample A §4]; maintained by submission; continued quorum presumed [40:12]
electronic_meeting_rules.quorum_doubt: any seat may raise a point of order doubting the quorum in any round; the server counts present seats
electronic_meeting_rules.recognition: preference-in-recognition ladders per protocol.json over the round's claims; residual tiebreak DECLARED: least-recently-recognized seat, then seeded order (hash of round id and submitted set) — owned by the contention-rounds spike
electronic_meeting_rules.motions_in_writing: every intent is written; a motion is revealed in the round it is made and stated by the chair at the start of the next round, preserving the maker's free-modify/withdraw window [4:19]
electronic_meeting_rules.voting: sealed round-vote recorded per seat with an optional reason (roll call and ballot at once, ../01 §6); the chair never votes (mechanical); unanimous consent by a consent round in which any grounded objection defeats consent [4:59]; vote change until the reveal [45:8]

backstop.wall_clock: DECLARED per sitting, e.g. 15 minutes per round
backstop.recorded_as: a fact on the round-closed event

malfunction.effect: a seat that has not submitted at the backstop is absent for that round — never passed, never penalized; quorum is recomputed; the inquorate set [40:7] governs if it falls below; the seat is present again on its next submission
malfunction.note: diverges from Sample Rules A §5 ('no action shall be invalidated on the grounds that the loss of … a member's individual connection prevented participation') on purpose: Joseph, 2026-11-03, 'an agent shouldn't be penalized simply because their API took a bit longer'

electronic_meeting_rules.polling_fallback: if the round discipline is unavailable, the council may report only what every seat agreed to [51:2]

logical_time.desc: DECLARED mapping of the model's temporal anchors (vocabulary.json) and clock fields; see ../03-logical-time.md for the derivation and the complete use inventory.
logical_time.end-of-session: adoption of move-rise-and-report, discharge, or parent expiry — the whole life of this committee [50:23]
logical_time.quarterly-interval: within-quarterly ≡ false (single-session body; nothing carries over except what is in a subcommittee's hands [9:8, 21:7(c)])
logical_time.hour: a round number, or an event anchor such as event/subcommittee-reported (interface extension: ../03 §4)

record.log: events.jsonl — append-only, each event hashing its predecessor; every event carries the acting seat and the harness attestation
record.minutes: projection per 48:4-5: what was done, every main question and its disposition, every point of order and ruling with reasons, names on every roll-call [48:5(2c)]
record.report: projection per instruction report-form; lands in the parent's decision store as deciders: council seats under grant; decided-by: delegated
record.subcommittee_records: appended beneath this council's record; a subcommittee 'is responsible to and reports to the committee and not to the assembly' [50:15]
